item.title: Karnataka to Ban Social Media Use for Children Under 16
item.description: GUWAHATI: The government of Karnataka has announced that social media use will be banned for children under the age of 16, citing growing concerns about the impact of excessive mobile phone usage on young minds. item.title: West Bengal Governor C.V. Ananda Bose Resigns Ahead of Assembly Polls, R.N. Ravi Gets Additional Charge
item.description: GUWAHATI: C. V. Ananda Bose, on Thursday, March 5, resigned as the Governor of West Bengal after serving for about three-and-a-half years. item.description: GUWAHATI: The United States has issued a temporary 30-day waiver allowing Indian refiners to purchase Russian crude oil currently stranded at sea, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Friday, March 6, describing the move as a short-term measure aimed at keeping global oil supplies flowing amid disruptions linked to the Middle East conflict. item.title: Domestic LPG Price up by ₹60, Commercial Cylinders by ₹115 amid West Asia Conflict
item.description: GUWAHATI: Domestic cooking gas prices have been increased across India, with the price of a 14.2-kg household LPG cylinder rising by ₹60, while commercial cylinders have become costlier by around ₹115.
